description: AccessSync test priority tiers — organized by business impact, not code coverage %.
principle: A 92% coverage score that misses the 'member pays but can't get in' path is worse than 70% coverage that fully covers it.

p1.label: Critical Path — Churn Risk
p1.businessConsequence: Member pays for gym membership and cannot enter the facility. Maximum churn risk. This is the most expensive bug regardless of how rarely it occurs.
scenarios: Member purchases Wix plan → access provisioned in hardware within 10 seconds
Member cancels plan → access revoked from all doors
Payment fails → access suspended (roles preserved for fast recovery)
Payment recovers → access re-enabled without re-provisioning

p2.label: Operator Onboarding — Revenue Risk
p2.businessConsequence: New gym operator cannot complete setup. Blocks new client revenue and onboarding.
scenarios: Kisi API key encrypts, stores, and decrypts correctly — no plaintext ever in DB
Plan mapping resolver gates inactive subscription locations (DR-027)
Operator completes 5-step wizard → client, location, mapping created in DB

p3.label: Data Integrity — Silent Failure Risk
p3.businessConsequence: Wrong data stored, wrong member provisioned, or duplicate operations executed. Silent failures that are hard to detect and damage trust.
scenarios: Wix webhook payload → member ID resolves correctly across all Wix event structures
Duplicate webhook does not trigger double-provisioning (idempotency)
In-flight lock prevents concurrent grant + revoke for same member (DR-011)

p4.label: Operator Visibility — Support Burden
p4.businessConsequence: Operator cannot diagnose access issues through the console. Increases support ticket volume.
scenarios: Error queue surfaces failed jobs with correct member + plan context
Member timeline shows accurate event history in chronological order
Dashboard member counts match DB actuals

p5.label: Admin Console UI — Low Business Risk
p5.businessConsequence: Visual or UX issue. Does not block access control operations or revenue.
scenarios: Dark mode preference persists across page navigation
Plan mapping drawer opens and closes without JS errors
Member search input returns results within 300ms

deployPolicy.message: Deploy is BLOCKED if any P1, P2, or P3 test fails. P4 failures trigger a warning. P5 failures are advisory only.
